description: TikTok’s own trend data through the connected TikTok ACCOUNT: kind "sounds" lists trending Commercial Music Library tracks — pre-cleared for organic posts AND ads — by genre (POP, HIP_HOP/RAP, ELECTRONIC … or ALL), country and period (1DAY/7DAY/30DAY/90DAY); "sound_videos" the top videos using one sound; "search_terms" the top 20 trending TikTok search terms; "search_suggestions" TikTok search keywords for a product, service or brand (query). Read-only, free.

countryCode.description: 2-letter country code the trend data is for, e.g. US

genre.description: music genre for kind sounds, e.g. POP or HIP_HOP/RAP, or ALL

kind.description: sounds (trending tracks), sound_videos (videos using soundId), search_terms, or search_suggestions (needs query)

personalized.description: search terms personalized for this account

soundId.description: for sound_videos — soundId from kind sounds

name: tiktok_trends
title: TikTok trending sounds and searches
